description: Screens a person, company, vessel or aircraft name against the OFAC SDN list (US Treasury), the UN Security Council consolidated list and the EU consolidated financial sanctions list. Fuzzy matching tolerates transliterations, reordered names, diacritics and punctuation; every match carries a 0-1 score, the list, the sanctions programs, aliases, title, nationality and remarks. The answer states the date of the list snapshot. No key, no quota to manage. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

type.description: individual, entity, vessel or aircraft (default any)
